span.p:
WriteBuffer Optimal Pairings:
• BTree for Bincode WriteBuffer (ordered flush)
• HashMap for Avro WriteBuffer (random access)
• DashMap for high-concurrency WriteBuffer

SST Optimal Pairings:
• BTree for SSTable generation
• SkipList for concurrent writes
• Both maintain sorted order
